title: Number 4 — Four Gospels
memory_verse: "Jesus went throughout Galilee, teaching and preaching the good news." — Matthew 4:23 (NIV, adapted)
objective: Students will learn the number 4 and discover that there are four books in the Bible called the Gospels that tell us about Jesus.
content: Today we are learning about the number 4! Hold up four fingers. Count them — one, two, three, four!

Did you know that there are FOUR special books in the Bible that tell us all about Jesus? They are called the Gospels. Their names are Matthew, Mark, Luke, and John. Let's say them together: Matthew, Mark, Luke, and John!

These four books tell us about when Jesus was born, the amazing things He did, how He healed sick people, and how much He loves everyone. The word 'Gospel' means 'Good News,' and Jesus is the best news ever!
activity: Make four mini booklets from folded paper. Write the name of each Gospel on one: Matthew, Mark, Luke, and John. Draw a picture of Jesus on each one. Practice writing the number 4.
discussion: How many Gospels are in the Bible?
Can you name the four Gospels?
